text:
priya: Heads up — final-round SRE interview Thurs 3:00pm PT. Need panel coverage, scribe, and clarity on eval template. Quick: who owns handoff and scribe? :wave:
samir: I can do interviewer + debrief. Happy to act as backup scribe if needed. Can lead infra deep-dive.
elena: I can join at 3:00 but must leave at 3:45. Can someone cover last 15m debrief? @mohit?
mohit: I can cover the ending and take notes. I'll handle the system design questions. Not comfortable being scribe for scoring though.
priya: Ok — @samk could you be primary scribe for the debrief and fill the eval form? Also which eval template — compact or detailed?
samk: compact template please. We want consistent 20-min windows. Anchors:
```
4 = Strong exec
3 = Meets bar
2 = Marginal
1 = Not hire
```
Use the 'compact-eval' doc: https://redwood.docs/internal/evals/compact-eval
people-ops-bot: Reminder — please submit debrief within 24h or auto-notify hiring manager. :alarm_clock:
priya: Thanks. @samir you'll lead tech q's, @mohit take system-design, @samk scribe. @elena will cover incident response question set briefly.
samir: Confirmed. I'll also ping the candidate test account creds in thread.
elena: Sending the runbook link: https://drive.redwood/candidates/runbooks/sre-runbook-v2.pdf
mohit: :thumbsup:
samk: :thumbsup: I'll fill scoring anchors in the form during the sync.
priya: I'll update calendar roles + attach compact-eval link. If anyone can't make it please say now. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.
